title: Indoor Activities for Kids and Teens: Rainy Day Fun
description: Indoor activities for kids and teenagers: trampoline parks, bowling, laser tag, soft play, climbing walls, arcades and cinema mornings. Perfect for rainy days.
intro: Rain? No problem. From soft play for toddlers to laser tag for teens, here’s indoor fun that burns off energy whatever the weather.

blocks.title: Scout’s indoor verdict
blocks.text: Indoor places fill up on wet weekends, so book a slot as soon as the forecast turns. Weekday sessions are usually cheaper.

sections.html:
• Trampoline parks usually require grip socks and a signed waiver.
  • Look for toddler-only and SEN-friendly quiet sessions.
  • Birthday packages can be good value for groups.

See trampoline park tips and rainy day ideas.

faqs.q: What can kids do indoors on a rainy day?
faqs.a: Trampoline parks, soft play, bowling, climbing walls, swimming, museums, aquariums and cinema mornings are all great rainy-day options.
